02 · Marquee Client

Executive Office
of the President

From 2017 to 2025, WDG served as a trusted digital partner to the White House, supporting whitehouse.gov across two administrations. Our work spanned information architecture, design, development, and project management for one of the most visible websites in the world.

WDG also served as partner liaison supporting digital platforms and tools to enhance communication efforts for the Biden-Harris White House.

04 · CMS Migration

The Ford Foundation

Known for its global grant-making influence, the Ford Foundation is passionate about the pursuit of human dignity worldwide. WDG migrated its public-facing site from Umbraco into WordPress Gutenberg, applying a revised brand refresh and streamlining the editorial experience.

Migration path
Umbraco → WordPress Gutenberg
★2024 Webby Award Nominee
How we migrated
01Connected to SQL server, importing titles, authors, URLs, body text, publication dates, abstracts, and taxonomy
02Applied revised brand guidelines across design with full accessibility compliance
03Rebuilt features in WordPress Gutenberg with visual editing replacing the classic editor
04Shipped streamlined publishing tools giving editors direct visual feedback during content creation

07 · Nonprofit UX Partnership

American Red Cross

For nearly a decade, WDG has partnered with the American Red Cross to enhance user experience across one of the nation's most critical humanitarian platforms. Our work spans iterative UX improvement, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization.

Mobile Donation Optimization
Refined the donor experience through iterative UI design, A/B testing, and user research, resulting in a more effective mobile donation flow.
Volunteer Role Finder
Devised a content strategy funnel to efficiently guide prospective volunteers, streamlining tasks across multiple systems and increasing engagement.
Homepage Redesign
Leveraged user behavior and personalization data to boost conversion rates, focusing on three core actions: seeking help, donating, and volunteering.
08 · Conservation Platform

National Fish & Wildlife Foundation

NFWF directs public conservation dollars to the highest-impact projects across the United States. WDG designed and built a bold, editorial WordPress platform that reflects the organization's commitment to conservation at scale: from the Great Lakes to coastal wetlands to endangered species recovery.

Full-bleed editorial design showcasing wildlife photography at hero scale
Conservation grant program pages with rich species and habitat content
Priority landscape sections including the Great Lakes Basin program
Accessible, performant WordPress build on enterprise hosting
$800M+

09 · Ideas Platform

The Aspen Institute

A nonpartisan forum for values-based leadership and the exchange of ideas, the Aspen Institute convenes leaders across sectors to address the most important challenges facing the world. WDG built and evolved their digital platform to reflect the organization's depth of thought and breadth of programming.

Content-rich article and research publishing platform with advanced taxonomy
Events and programs architecture supporting hundreds of annual convenings
Accessibility-first design with WCAG 2.1 compliance including audio descriptions
Multimedia content: podcasts, videos, transcripts, and interactive data

01 · CMS Migration
From legacy systems
to WordPress at scale.
Every migration starts with understanding content architecture, not just the data. WDG has migrated Drupal, Umbraco, and proprietary headless platforms to WordPress Gutenberg, preserving structured content, taxonomy, and editorial workflows. We connect directly to source databases, rebuild block systems, and ship platforms editors actually want to use. Featured work: Ford Foundation, NLC, World Central Kitchen.

Member experiences
that actually work.
For associations and policy organizations, identity is infrastructure. WDG has implemented SSO solutions, member portals with personalization, saved resources, and governance models that give the right people access to the right content. We've done this at scale for NACo and NLC, where member engagement is mission-critical and systems must be reliable for thousands of concurrent users.

Search & Discovery
04
Search & Discovery
SOLR-powered dynamic filtering for large content libraries. Resources, policy content, and taxonomy at scale.
04 · Search & Discovery
Content libraries
people can actually find.
Large policy and resource libraries are only as useful as their search. WDG implemented SOLR-powered dynamic filtering for NLC's Resource Library, enabling faceted search by city size, region, topic, program type, and audience. The result is a discovery experience that surfaces the right content for each user, reducing friction and increasing engagement across a complex content ecosystem.

05 · Integrations

Modern nonprofit and association operations run on multiple platforms. WDG connects them. We've also worked with AMS platforms ensuring data flows where it's needed without manual intervention.
